question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing left midfielder, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing right midfielder, Fred is playing left back, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Finally, Fred and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) left midfielder
(C) striker
(D) center midfielder
(E) right midfielder
(F) left back
(G) right winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: right back, left midfielder, striker, center midfielder, right midfielder, left back, right winger
1. Dave ↔ Eve: right back, left midfielder, striker, right midfielder, center midfielder, left back, right winger
2. Fred ↔ Eve: right back, left midfielder, striker, right midfielder, left back, center midfielder, right winger
3. Claire ↔ Alice: striker, left midfielder, right back, right midfielder, left back, center midfielder, right winger
4. Gertrude ↔ Eve: striker, left midfielder, right back, right midfielder, right winger, center midfielder, left back
5. Eve ↔ Bob: striker, right winger, right back, right midfielder, left midfielder, center midfielder, left back
6. Fred ↔ Bob: striker, center midfielder, right back, right midfielder, left midfielder, right winger, left back
7. Fred ↔ Dave: striker, center midfielder, right back, right winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back
Bob is the center midfielder, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
